quest.title: Ice-Frosted Endgame
quest.description: Behind the turmoil, a cold truth awaits...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x650, Primogem x60, Mora x53900, Guide to Justice x5, Recipe: Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version x1, Hero's Wit x6, Mystic Enhancement Ore x12

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, why are we here so early? Our meeting with Vaneigem isn't for a while...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wanted to check on Escoffier...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Check on her? Why, what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! Escoffier! Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: ...I'm fine... Just need to get some more coffee in me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really did pull an all-nighter, then...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Huh? What happened to my coffee? ...Did I really drink it all?

choices.text: Let me get you a fresh one.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Alright... *yawn* Thanks, I appreciate it...

choices.text: For now, you should get some rest.

talks.objective: Go to Hotel Debord and look for Escoffier

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Hello! What can I get for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I need coffee, stat!

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Sure thing. For here or to go?

choices.text: To go, please!

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Huh? Ohh, I see... First cup of the season, huh? Yeah, I get it. Young people these days do love their little surprises, hehe...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (...? Not convinced we're on the same page here. But I'm not here to chat — let's get this coffee to Escoffier!)

choices.text: I'm grabbing it for a friend.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Coffee... Need coffee...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: #Phew... I feel much better now! Thank you so much, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Glad to hear it... But make sure to catch up on your sleep when you get the chance!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How goes the investigation?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Heh... I think I've figured out where the problem lies. Honestly, it's ridiculous, I don't know whether to laugh or cry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what investigation? What are you guys talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I'll save it for when everyone else gets here. It's so stupidly small, I can't believe it's caused so much drama...

choices.text: And yet... look at this kitchen...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Ahem... Yes, except my failures were stepping stones to success!

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: Escoffier! Have you seen Savanna?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Huh? No, not since yesterday... Why, what's wrong?

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: After seeing her home yesterday, we were all a little concerned about how she was doing... so, I dropped by her place early this morning to check on her...

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: Only to find an empty house with the doors wide open!

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: I left Alphonse and the others to keep watch at her home while I check the Hotel Debord... I'm worried something bad might have happened...

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: If she's not here... then where could she be?

response.speaker: Alphonse
response.text: Boss, Escoffier! Bad news!

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: Alphonse? You're supposed to be keeping watch at Savanna's house...

response.speaker: Gaspard
response.text: We were, but then... just after you left, we found this stuff in her house!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Looks like a map, with a bunch of random places circled... What does it mean?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Wait a second, this feels familiar... I'm sure these places are all connected somehow...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Ah! Of course, from the Codex... They're all places that Modeste explored on his adventures!

choices.text: Modeste?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Yeah... But I don't understand — the adventure logs in the Codex are too fragmented to be of any use. How come this map shows all the missing details?

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: The Codex Debord? Then, this place marked in red out at sea — could that be the fabled birthplace of Gateau Debord?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? So now she's set her sights on finding the original recipe and beating Escoffier that way? Geez, Savanna... anything to overcome a gateau plateau, huh?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Ugh, idiot! Does she have a death wish? Those ruins are thousands of years old!

response.speaker: Alphonse
response.text: Hold on... There's more. Besides the map, we also found these letters...

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: "...It was you. You let the lumiline through, didn't you?"

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: It sounds like a threat letter... Does this mean that Savanna was responsible for the safety incident? And not Monica after all?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "...Retrieve the Codex. By any means necessary!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So the cooking contest, and the cheating... Someone else was behind her, pulling the strings?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: "...She's keeping the true recipe to herself..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... This is all such a mess. Paimon needs a second to process this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: First we thought that Savanna forced Monica to cheat in the cooking contest... But now, it turns out that someone else... forced Savanna to force Monica to cheat?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, did Savanna blackmail Monica...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Or is it the other way round?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Meanwhile, somewhere deep beneath the sea...

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: ...You're finally here.

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: Of course... I should have put two and two together as soon as I read your threat letter... The food safety incident, the demand for a cooking contest, the instruction to blackmail Monica...

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: ...Even the suggestion that Escoffier was keeping secrets from me... It was all part of your grand plan — wasn't it, Monica?

choices.text: The founder of the Hotel Debord?
Seems like you had your own share of failed experiments last night.

talks.objective: Find a way to get underwater

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I smell... coffee!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... This place looks like an underwater restaurant, doesn't it? Suddenly, the idea of an adventure-chef finding secret ingredients makes a whole lot more sense...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I think Modeste's Codex mentioned this place... a public bath from the time of Remuria. So yeah, definitely the kind of place that would have served food and drinks...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Some Blubberbeasts have come to join the party... How did they get here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw! They ran off!

choices.text: Guess they're not used to seeing humans.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: That could be easier said than done... Something's blocking the entrance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Well, did Modeste mention it in his adventure logs by any chance? They must have gotten through somehow.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Good point... Umm... Yes, that's right, it's coming back to me now...

response.speaker: Modeste
response.text: "We prepared a banquet for our shy little guests... And as the food flowed away on the current, they broke into a joyous chorus, and the path opened to us."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... We have to feed the Blubberbeasts? With what? There's nothing here besides rocks, Romaritime Flowers, and Lumitoile...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...See, this is why you should always bring snacks — you never know when you're gonna need 'em! Now, we have to head all the way back to shore and grab some!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: There's no time for that. Romaritime Flowers and Lumitoile will have to do... They may not look appetizing to us, but who knows — they could be Blubberbeast delicacies!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Wait, we're seriously gonna try this?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You collect the Romaritime Flowers and Lumitoiles in the surrounding area...

choices.text: Let's head further in.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Uh... Ugh... What's this? Hmm... I know some people like to use pungent flavors to wake themselves up, but... Not for me, thank you very much.

talks.objective: Make a dish for the Blubberbeast

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Blubberbeasts or not, are we sure this stuff is edible?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Hehe... Trust me, they'll love it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: More pertinently... How do we actually feed it to them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good question... If we try to put them in the pool, we'll probably just scare them off again, and who knows how long they'll be gone...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Yes, we can't afford to wait for them to double back... What was it that Modeste said again? Something about the food "flowing away on the current."

talks.objective: Use the waterway to transport dishes

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Mmm... Strong, bitter coffee beans, transformed through expert brewing, and balanced perfectly with rich, creamy steamed milk... Wonderful!

talks.objective: Make a dish for the Blubberbeast

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Some time ago...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Phew... Hey, give me your water.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Here.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Hmm? I said YOUR water. The one you just drank out of.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Sure.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: *chug* *chug* Ahhh...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: All those years slaving away under Escoffier, and then you... Hmph, today, it's finally paying off!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Not only have I found the ruin that Savelli kept hidden... but I also get to boss you around like my little lapdog.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Hey, go scout ahead for me. If we need to do any more blast-tunneling, I want to know where to lay the explosives.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Did you not hear me? Get going!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Why don't you do it yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Oh? When did you learn to fight back? You're always so compliant when I give you instructions by letter...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: That's because you threatened to expose me for the lumiline incident! I swear, If I'd known what you were planning, I'd never have...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Ha, don't be so self-righteous. Admit it, you've always been jealous of Escoffier! That's why you lapped up everything I told you...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: You were terrified of her finding out about your part in the lumiline incident, and you resented the way her reputation hung over you...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: So you jumped at the chance to convince yourself that she was the villain, that she deliberately hid her secret recipes from you just to hold you back... It was the only excuse you needed to justify getting back at her!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: First idolization, then jealousy, suspicion, and self-deception... That's what this comes down to. It was the same story with Savelli and my ancestor!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: He offered Modeste his friendship, only to murder him out of vanity...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: He promised to explore the world with him, only to later destroy all records of their adventures... It's a miracle I even found this place! You have no idea, the countless hours I spent piecing it all together...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: ...Hmph, so you see? You're no better than Savelli. If you can't beat 'em, betray 'em, right?

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...I am no Savelli, nor will I ever be.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Oh, put a lid on it! You really think you can absolve yourself of your vindictive and jealous behavior now? Just because you finally realize that Escoffier never kept any secrets from you?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: You didn't show any remorse when she left, or in the cooking contest. Why start now? You have no right to redemption!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: You're right, I don't deserve her forgiveness... But I am done being bullied into submission by YOU!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Ooh, feisty. But you should watch your tone. Talking to me like that could get you in big trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: I somehow doubt that... Since I poisoned both our water bottles.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: ...! What!?

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Ever since I learned the truth... I've been biding my time, waiting for this moment! You've played me like a fiddle for so long... and now, this is payback!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: But... But you drank it too!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...It's what we both deserve. This is the price we must pay for betraying Escoffier... You'll die here with me, Monica!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: You... You...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: ...Hahaha... Hahahahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Wh—What's so funny?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Haha... Ahh, you're too much. I thought I'd play along for a bit just to amuse myself. You gave a very rousing performance.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: I saw your dumb plan a mile off. There's no poison in these bottles, just clean, fresh water.

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Revenge is a dish best served cold, you know... did you really think your half-baked plot would fool me?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: You're a lousy chef, and you make a lousy villain too. A complete waste of space... No wonder you never amounted to anything.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Everything I ever did was a failure... and now, I've failed again, for the last time...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Hey, why don't you try your hand at being a comedian in your next life? You got a good laugh outta me, heh. But now the show's over...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: You should have just done like I asked, Savanna. All I wanted you to do was scout the ruins for me... But you had your chance, and now it's time to say goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Stop right there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let her go, Monica! We've got you surrounded!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Escoffier...?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Ugh! Looks like I'll have to keep you around for a little longer.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: You can't... Agh!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Stay back if you want her alive!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: #Escoffier and {NICKNAME}... Hmph, I can't take you both on in combat, but if you so much as flinch, I can end Savanna's life in a heartbeat!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Monica... What are you hoping to achieve by this? You're about to commit murder — and for what? A recipe!?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: A recipe? Hah! You chefs are all blinded by your myopic focus on kitchen affairs. Well, some of us actually have bigger fish to fry...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Modeste had a secret... the truth behind his so-called genius, the "je ne sais quoi" factor in his Gateau Debord... and it's right here in these ruins!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: ...Are you serious? You're here because of a Gateau Debord obsession? You've gone completely mad!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Hahaha, I couldn't care less about the cake itself. No, the real treasure is the secret ingredient that Modeste sourced from these ruins!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: He and Savelli were fools. A priceless treasure of Remuria in the palms of their hands, and they thought "Ooh, this would go great in our cake mix"!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: We're talking about a powerful stimulant that also sharpens the senses. That's no cooking ingredient... it's a groundbreaking drug!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: That's right, I've done my research... It was a drug that Remuria developed for their war machine. I could make a killing by selling it to the Treasure Hoarders or the Fatui!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Will you listen to yourself? You're completely delusional!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Hmph, my eyes are wide open! Just wait till I get my hands on this treasure, you'll see what a fool you've been!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... What's that sound!?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: *cough* Just when I thought she couldn't get any crazier... She's lucky the whole place didn't collapse!

choices.text: Seems like she escaped in the commotion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh... Savanna's gone, too!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Monica must have taken her... Ugh, what a coward! She's only taking her hostage because she knows that she's no match for you!

choices.text: Well, there is one piece of good news.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. Even if she finds the treasure, she'll need Savanna alive if she wants to get out of here in one piece.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Hmm... Well, our path's been blocked, so let's look for another route.

choices.text: At least Savanna is safe for now.
Let's find another route, and go after her.

talks.objective: Look for a way forward nearby

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Engraving
dialogues.text: "...Following the exalted Harmost (...) order, and in accordance with our Sebastos's most sacred, most benevolent temper, we establish here a (...) as condolences for the naturalized barbarian soldiers... Savages they may have been, but they were also warriors."

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Engraving
dialogues.text: "...With this secret treasure, granted graciously... the warriors' bodily desires are satisfied, that they may fight on with hundredfold bravery..."

talks.objective: Make a dish for the Blubberbeast
Use the waterway to transport dishes
Make a dish for the Blubberbeast

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: That's strange... these don't look Remurian to me. More like last-century Fontaine.

choices.text: They don't look that worn, either.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Adventurers from last-century Fontaine, huh... *gasp* Modeste and Savelli! Do you think they camped here?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: By the looks of it, this was a one-person camp. They adventured together, but... maybe one of them came back alone at a later date?

choices.text: Let's rummage around.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Huh? You really think so?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Trust our adventurers' instincts! We're pros at this stuff, just like you're a pro in the kitchen!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well... I'm a pro, at least.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Uhh... Okay, well the {NICKNAME} has more adventuring experience overall, but... Paimon's definitely a pro rummager from all those treasure chests!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...And bingo. Found it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Darn it! Paimon was just about to show off her rummaging skills!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Huh, no kidding... Are all adventurers so obsessed with journaling? ...I mean, I guess I take a lot of notes when I'm cooking as well, but I thought that was just me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ahem... Anyway, let's find out who was here!
...It's been years since I've last visited these ruins.
It's exactly the way I remember it. This place probably hasn't changed in millennia.
Sadly... Up above, on dry land, everything has changed...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: The "Treasure of Remuria" — that's what we used to call it. Modeste was right about its potential. It turned Gateau Debord into a national sensation.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Our limited stock of the substance meant that the gateau could only be produced on a small scale, but this only drove up the popularity all the more. Modeste was right about that, too. He predicted all of it.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: He was praised as a genius, while I, as the one person who'd ever disagreed with him, was labeled a talentless fool...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Modeste tried his best to console me, but I knew better than anyone just how great the gulf was between us.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Our conversations grew scarce, and we saw less and less of each other. I didn't fight it. He had new friends and a career of his own — why invite further disdain by inserting myself where I did not belong?

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: I told myself that maybe one day, when I've finally created a masterpiece of my own, I would be able to face him without shame.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Or maybe one day, when I've put these feelings of self-loathing behind me... I'd be able to ask him with a smile on my face: "How about we go on one more adventure, for old times' sake?"

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Unfortunately... that day will never come.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So it was Savelli! From the sounds of it... he came back after Modeste had already died.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: I always thought it was just a legend... But if it's true, then... This must be the place where they found their secret ingredient. The birthplace of Gateau Debord...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that case... What does that say about the death of Modeste? If it's all true, maybe Savelli really did have something to do with it...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's keep reading...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: "The taste of Gateau Debord has changed." Modeste was convinced of this, even though everyone swore that they couldn't tell...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Being the perfectionist that he was, he refused to accept even the slightest flaw in his work. He stopped all sales of the product, locked himself away in the kitchen, and worked day and night, vowing to find out where he had gone wrong...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: But as he baked and taste-tested over and over again, he found he only strayed further and further from the original taste.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: It was only when he was sipping on coffee one day and realized he could not taste the bitterness that the truth finally dawned on him: What had changed was not the gateau, but his sense of taste.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: The Treasure of Remuria stimulates the senses — taste included — and invigorates the spirit. In the short term, it offers people the ultimate gourmet experience... but in the long term, it dulls their senses entirely.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: In hindsight, it made perfect sense. After all, why would a culture that sought liberation from the constraints of their bodies care for the loss of their senses? But we realized it too late. We were just too late...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Over the course of his many culinary experiments, Modeste exhausted the remaining supply of the Treasure of Remuria... he consumed it all himself.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: The finest culinary talent of his generation now faced a future in which he would never be able to taste anything ever again... Finally, in despair, he took his own life.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: And because we had become estranged, I could not be there to stop him, to offer some words of comfort, or even to say goodbye.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Yet despite everything... he sent me his final letter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Treasure of Remuria... Guess Monica was actually onto something. It really was a kind of drug!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: So, Modeste chose to end his own life... Then, why all the rumors that Savelli murdered him?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Also, neither the Codex nor any other contemporary records make any mention of the Treasure of Remuria. It's almost as if... someone deliberately erased it from history.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: ...Modeste told me everything in his final letter. His was a tale of how even a genius could fail, and how much more devastating it is when it happens..

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: Did he hope I would gain some personal catharsis from knowing the truth? Or maybe he wished for me to warn the public about the dangers of Gateau Debord, proving that I had been right all along?

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: But if the public ever learned how Modeste's greatest triumph became his undoing, his fall from grace would be swift and merciless. One minute a genius, the next a joke. It would surely spell the end for his restaurant, too.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: What would be his legacy then? How would future generations view everything we built together? I fear the scorn I have faced these last years would pale in comparison to the scorn shown to him by the history books...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: I cannot let that come to pass.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: I will do what I must to protect his name. It will mean tampering with his notes to remove the damning details, leaving mere fragments of our story behind...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: It may lead his family to suspect me of having a hand in his demise, but if that's the price of destroying all evidence of my crimes... Then, so be it.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: I would rather the world believe a tale of genius and jealousy than see his reputation in tatters.

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: ...The final loose end is the evidence here, at the bottom of the sea...

response.speaker: Savelli
response.text: ...The final loose end is the evidence here, at the bottom of the sea...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Oh no... We've got to stop Monica!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What's wrong? Didn't we say Savanna should be safe for now?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: So we thought, but if Monica finds out what happened to the treasure... There's no telling what she might do!

choices.text: They may have left a journal or something.
Could they have been left by previous adventurers?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: ...The Treasure of Remuria... I have found you at last!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Savelli, you tried your best to bury the truth, but you underestimated the children of Modeste! Some fragments of his diary escaped your clutches, and we have held onto them for generations!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Heh... But I have to thank you too, Savanna. Without your help retrieving the Codex, and with it the last piece of the puzzle, I may never have found this place...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: But now, finally, the secret to Remuria's military might is within my grasp... the Treasure of Remuria is mine!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: It's... empty?

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: It's EMPTY!?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Monica...! Ugh, we were seconds too late!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Escoffier? What's the deal with that jar?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: ...Savelli's final act... He wanted to conceal the secret of the treasure forevermore, and make sure it would never harm anyone again...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: So he came here after his friend's death, and destroyed every last shred that remained!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: ...This can't be happening! All the years I spent piecing together the truth... All my painstaking planning...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: All that... for an empty jar!?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Monica! Don't do anything stupid! This ruin is more dangerous than you realize...

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Oh, shut your pie-hole!

dialogues.speaker: Praetorian Golem
dialogues.text: Praise be... to Lord Remus!

dialogues.speaker: Praetorian Golem
dialogues.text: You barbarians shall be slain!

dialogues.speaker: Monica
dialogues.text: Aah... Aaaah!!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaah! Why is this place still shaking!?

choices.text: Maybe it's because of the fighting?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph! Either way, it's all her fault!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Enough chit-chat, let's get outta here! {NICKNAME}, Escoffier, come on!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Okay! I'm coming... Huh?

response.speaker: Monica
response.text: ...Oh no you don't! Hah... If I can't get what I want, neither will any of you!

response.speaker: Monica
response.text: Hahaha... I've got nothing to show for my life's work so far. But if I can take another so-called genius down with me in my final moment... then it was all worth it!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: You're a psycho!
Hyah!

response.speaker: Monica
response.text: ...S—Savanna?

response.speaker: Monica
response.text: When did you... wake up...

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: Phew... Heh...

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: ...I may be a lousy chef, but it looks like I'm not a complete waste of space.

choices.text: Hey, we need to go!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: #{NICKNAME}... Okay, let's go!

choices.text: We're out of time!
Or maybe because Monica was too trigger-happy with her explosives!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: *coughing*... *coughing*...

dialogues.speaker: Alphonse
dialogues.text: Escoffier! Savanna!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! ...And Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Vaneigem? What are you all doing here...?

dialogues.speaker: Gaspard
dialogues.text: #*sigh* What did you expect us to do? Stay at the restaurant and sit on our merry derrieres? While {NICKNAME} and Escoffier were out here risking their lives?

dialogues.speaker: Alphonse
dialogues.text: We had to do something... even though that something ended up being, well, waiting for you here instead... Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: I... I don't deserve any of you... and I certainly don't deserve to be your head chef...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: It was my fault Escoffier had to leave... Then I couldn't live up to her standards... I acted like a tyrant in the kitchen... And now, I almost got myself killed...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Come back, Escoffier! Come and be our head chef again! I... I'll never be able to replace you!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Okay, so... Everything I said to you the day I left — it just went in one ear and out the other?

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Huh? Sorry, I was kinda in my own head at the time... All I could think about was the lumiline situation... What was it you said, again...?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Forget it, it doesn't matter... Anyway, I didn't leave this job because of you. And... you're not nearly as awful a chef as you think.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: If you were that bad, why would all your staff show up here for you?

dialogues.speaker: Alphonse
dialogues.text: Escoffier's right! Sure, you nitpick our work and get us to do things over a lot... but when it comes down to it, you're the one who's always doing whatever it takes to make sure the customers get served on time, every time!

dialogues.speaker: Gaspard
dialogues.text: Things were pretty rough after Escoffier left... and Savanna's the only reason we've been able to make it through.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Our customers know that Escoffier doesn't work for us anymore — but the fact is, they keep coming back. If that's not an endorsement of your work... I don't know what is.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: At the end of the day, we're all human, and we all make mistakes. All we can do is recognize where we get it wrong, and do our best to improve... That's all that's humanly possible.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: No, I... I get what you're saying but, what I did to Firmin, and to Escoffier... it's unforgiveable!

dialogues.speaker: Alphonse
dialogues.text: Well, about that... There's someone else here to see you, Chef.

dialogues.speaker: Firmin
dialogues.text: ...It's been a while, Chef Savanna.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Firmin? I...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...I'm so sorry, I... I put far too much pressure on you. And the way I stubbornly refused to go and see you after you fell ill... there's no excuse.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: But... I'm too late, aren't I? The damage is done. I heard that... you can't even hold a kitchen knife anymore...

dialogues.speaker: Firmin
dialogues.text: Actually... I think I'm going to be just fine.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: We thought Firmin's problem was purely psychological in nature, but after the threat letter came to light, it got Firmin thinking... and then, he remembered the tea that Monica used to give him every night.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: And as it turns out... She was lacing it with lumiline the whole time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No way... Doesn't that cause nerve damage?

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: It can. High doses pose a risk of serious nervous and sensory complications, but if you calculate the dosage carefully, you can control the extent of its effects...

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: A small dose might simply make a person more emotional, whether that mean more fragile or more hot-tempered...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: No wonder it seemed like you'd lost your edge...

dialogues.speaker: Firmin
dialogues.text: Haha... I asked my friends at the Fontaine Research Institute about it — they said that with the low dose I was taking, the risks are pretty small. They also fixed me up with some meds, and said I should recover in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're already sounding a lot more confident.

dialogues.speaker: Firmin
dialogues.text: Heh, well that's what happens when you give someone a little bit of hope to cling on to.

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: There's... more. We believe that... Firmin was likely not Monica's only victim.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: You mean... She poisoned me, too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh... So THAT'S why Savanna's been so irritable this whole time!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Hmph, let's not be too quick to blame everything on the lumiline. That stuff can only amplify what's already there. So tasty food will seem like the most delicious thing in the world, while food you don't particularly care for will become utterly revolting...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: So you'd better make sure you reflect on your behavior, and apologize to every single person you've wronged.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...I will.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...I'm sorry, there's still one question that's really bugging me. Why is it... that no matter what I do, my Gateau Debord never tastes the same as yours?

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Is it just... I mean, is it because... you're a genius, and I'm not?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: It's because the heating element in your oven is broken, you silly goose.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: What?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Is that it?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I felt like something was off during the cooking contest. Once I got around to checking all the equipment, I noticed it right away: There was a half-degree discrepancy between the temperature setting and the actual temperature.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: All the ovens in the whole kitchen had the same problem, which confused me at the time. But by this point, it's pretty obvious that Monica must have tampered with them.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I would have figured it out the day of the bake-off, since the issue affected both our teams... But of course, Monica sabotaged mine so that could never happen.

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: No...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: I spent so long trying to find out where I was going wrong, and then you pinpoint the problem in just one night...

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...It all comes back to one simple, undeniable truth: You're a genius, and I'm just plain old Savanna.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Oh, cut it out! Stop the "woe is me" act for a second and just think. I came up with this recipe. You don't think that might have something to do with it?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Do you know how long I spent perfecting my Gateau Debord? Three years. Three whole years! I know this dish inside out, back to front, and upside down.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: And you've been head chef now for what, six months? If that? A couple hundred failed attempts, and you're gonna throw in the kitchen towel? And declare, you'll never be successful because you're not a genius?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: You clearly have no idea how many kitchen failures I have under my belt! Or just how long it took me to finally get my recipe to a level I was satisfied with.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Genius or not, everyone makes mistakes. Modeste did, Savelli did, everyone does.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: You're only a lousy chef if you don't face up to your mistakes, learn from them, and then keep chipping away until you crack the problem once and for all.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Surely you haven't forgotten all that? You were no lousy chef back when I handed you the reins!

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: I—

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: ...I haven't forgotten. And I'll make sure I never do.

dialogues.speaker: Alphonse
dialogues.text: Ahh... That's our head chef!

dialogues.speaker: Vaneigem
dialogues.text: Haha! Sounds like we won't need another changing of the guard in the Hotel Debord kitchen any time soon. Huzzah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww... What a perfect ending to a crazy journey... Look how happy everyone is!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Hmph... So, got your mojo back now?

dialogues.speaker: Savanna
dialogues.text: Yeah... Thanks to you, Escoffier. In fact, no... thanks to all of you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh, friends again! So nice to see them finally settle their beef.

choices.text: Yeah, it's nice.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Good. So, now that's out the way...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: It's time for payback! You cheated in our last bake-off, and I demand a rematch, right now!

response.speaker: Paimon & Alphonse & Gaspard
response.text: ...Huh?

response.speaker: Alphonse
response.text: ...Huh?

response.speaker: Gaspard
response.text: ...Huh?

response.speaker: Savanna
response.text: I, uhh... Eh?

response.speaker: Alphonse
response.text: But... But that was mostly Monica's fault, wasn't it?

response.speaker: Vaneigem
response.text: Right, and also... Does it have to be right now? Savanna's only just got her mojo back, and you barely escaped from a death trap...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: No excuses! This is a cooking contest between two top chefs, and nothing will stand in its way!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: So grab your spatula and get ready — 'cause this rematch is happening, today! Right now! This instant!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! So, um... This whole time you were salty about losing...

choices.text: Umm... Maybe not ALL their beef...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...The results are in. A landslide victory for Escoffier!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Hmph, quite rightly too. Piece of cake.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Her tail seems very happy with the results.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, look at that... And Savanna looks pretty chipper too, considering she lost!

choices.text: This wasn't for you, was it?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Ahem! Now, where were we? Ah yes, do you have any more questions for me, after everything that's happened?

choices.text: What are your future plans?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: ...Huh? I thought Navia would have filled you in... And actually, I said all this to Savanna before I left. Although, as we saw, I don't think any of it sank in...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: I had two reasons for leaving. One was the food safety incident, of course, but the other was that the Hotel Debord had reached a point where it didn't need me anymore.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: So, I decided to step down, and look for new opportunities to improve myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Improve how?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Well... A while back, I got to know a fellow chef from Liyue, and in her, I saw so many new possibilities...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: ...She has that same adventurous spirit that Modeste and Savelli had in their youth. Slime mucus, Lizard Tails... With her, nothing's off the table.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: ...There's a whole world of new flavors out there waiting to be explored, hiding away in ingredients we overlook...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Case in point — remember those Romaritime Flowers down in the ruins? I used them in the cooking contest just now! Did you taste the difference?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!? Paimon didn't notice at all!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Hehe... Half of the art of cooking is dissecting the recipes of previous chefs, and figuring out the exact constellation of elements that gave their work its signature taste.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: And the other half... It lies in freeing yourself from the confines of the kitchen. You've got to go out and explore the endless possibilities out there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh... Paimon's suddenly not sure she wants to try your cooking anymore...

choices.text: Well, I'm always down to be your taste-tester.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Hehe, don't worry, it's not gonna be a free-for-all like in Modeste's time. Before I put anything into my food, I'll obviously do my research, make sure it doesn't contain any harmful substances.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: In the meantime... Take this. It's a recipe for Petit Gateau Debord: Revised Version. I tweaked it to suit your needs as busy adventurers. Hope you enjoy, and remember — feedback is always welcome!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright... So, do you ever see yourself returning to Hotel Debord?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Oh, of course! I've already promised Vaneigem that I'll come back every once in a while to make sure the quality of the food remains at an acceptable level.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Good luck to Savanna, I guess...)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...*sigh* Y'know, Paimon's still a little disappointed that we never got to see the Treasure of Remuria...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Surely Monica wouldn't have gotten drawn in so deeply if it wasn't for all the mystery surrounding the original Gateau Debord.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She practically dedicated her life to finding the lost pieces of Modeste's diary, then went to all that trouble to infiltrate the Hotel Debord... and in the end, it was all for nothing.

choices.text: She sold her soul for a dream... then had a rude awakening.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Since you mention the treasure... Between Modeste's writings and what we saw in those ruins, I think I may have figured out the truth...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: The so-called Treasure of Remuria was most likely a substance that the Remurians extracted from Lumitoiles... better known to us as lumiline.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? So then... why all the hype back in the early days of Gateau Debord?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Don't forget, it was a very different era. We could barely even refine sugar back then, so desserts were very much in their infancy. In a world of bland food, it's no wonder that the first thing to really excite people's tastebuds took the world by storm.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: And as for lumiline... It may well have been somewhat valuable in ancient times. But these days, it's just another drug from the Fontaine Research Institute.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Even if Savelli hadn't destroyed it all, I doubt it'd be worth that much these days.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So after all that, there was nothing in those ruins but worthless junk!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Feels strange to say it, but Paimon almost feels sorry for Monica. She sacrificed it all, only to get nothing in return...

choices.text: She got exactly what she deserved.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hey!

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Huh? Navia?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: You just got back from that underwater ruin, right? Well, check it out: They ran a special issue!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Did you see anything like this down there? "Freshly unearthed from the ruins of Remuria! A magnificent jar thought to be over a thousand years old!"

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Experts say it has immense artistic and historical value! ...It could be worth an absolute fortune!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... Isn't that the jar they used to hold the Treasure!?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: ...If only it was still in one piece! Some butterfingers must have dropped it or something! Ugh, it's such a shame!

choices.text: Yes Paimon, poor, poor Monica...
Her life's work became a grand exercise in futility.
You should definitely make Paimon test all of your most experimental dishes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

choices.text: Are you going to stay at the Fleuve Cendre?
You did this for Savanna's sake.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Heh... Thank you for your words of encouragement. I'm gonna head to the Hotel Debord and spend the night investigating. I guess I'll see you tomorrow.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: "Genius"? Ugh. Calling someone a genius is just another way of saying, "I'm too lazy to figure out how I need to improve." It's a defeatist attitude, and I won't stand for it!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: That should be enough flavoring... Now hurry up and balance the flavors.

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Engraving
dialogues.text: "...The barbarians who take the (...) are gradually losing part of (...) ... There is no cause for worry."

dialogues.speaker: Barely-Legible Engraving
dialogues.text: "...The desire to break free from forms of flesh and blood... is also the first step to guiding them toward accepting civilization..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, there's cooking facilities here, or we could just grab a cup of coffee from Café Lutece... But either way, hurry!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should be getting close to the spot marked on the map!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Gah, of all the stupid things she's done, this really takes the cake! The moment we find her, I am going to curse the living daylights out of her!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: She's a nutcase! A liability to herself and everyone else...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: #Well, now it's up to us to clean up the mess she's made — take these golems out, {NICKNAME}!
